sharedRules.name: Voice of Command
sharedRules.description:
If your Army Faction is ASTRA MILITARUM:
  - At the start of your Command phase or at the end of each phase, if this unit disembarked from a Transport this phase or this unit was set up this phase, until the start of your next Command phase:
    - OFFICER models can issue up to one or more Orders to eligible friendly units within 6" that are not Battle-shocked, each one of:
      - MOVE! MOVE! MOVE: Add 3" to this unit's Move characteristic.
      - FIX BAYONETS: Improve the Weapon Skill characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
      - TAKE AIM: Improve the Ballistic Skill characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
      - FIRST RANK, FIRE! SECOND RANK, FIRE: Improve the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons with [RAPID FIRE] equipped by models in this unit by 1.
      - TAKE COVER: Improve this unit's Save characteristic by 1, to no better than 3+.
      - DUTY AND HONOUR: Improve this unit's Leadership characteristic by 1; improve this unit's Objective Control characteristic by 1.
    A unit holds at most one Order; a newer Order replaces it.
    An Order ends when its unit becomes Battle-shocked.
    Only ASTRA MILITARUM models in that unit benefit from its Order.

While making ranged attacks against MONSTER or VEHICLE targets, ranged weapons equipped by friendly SQUADRON units gain [LETHAL HITS].

rules.name: Ruthless Discipline
rules.description:
Increase the number of uses of friendly ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER models' Voice of Command ability by 1.
You can re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units that are designated as Affected By Order.

rules.name: Fire Zone Purge
rules.description:
If your army includes a MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER model that is the Warlord:
  - Friendly TEMPESTUS SCIONS units gain the BATTLELINE keyword.
  - Improve friendly TEMPESTUS SCIONS units' Objective Control characteristic by 1.
When a friendly MILITARUM TEMPESTUS unit is selected to shoot, until the end of the phase, if the triggering unit was set up this turn, add 1 to the triggering unit's Hit rolls with ranged weapons.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM units.

rules.name: Armoured Fist
rules.description: While making ranged attacks, if this unit disembarked from a Transport this turn, add 1 to friendly ASTRA MILITARUM models' Wound rolls.

rules.name: Artillery Support
rules.description:
At the start of the battle round:
  Choose one of the following (Artillery Support):
    - Until the end of the battle round, for each enemy unit, up to 2/3/4 units (Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught) of your choice: while this unit is not within 12" of a friendly unit, roll one D6: on a 5+, that unit is shaken; while this unit is shaken, subtract 2" from that unit's Move characteristic; while this unit is shaken, subtract 2 from that unit's Charge rolls.
    - Until the end of the battle round, select up to 2/3/4 enemy units (Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught) that is not within 12" of a friendly unit; those units are scattered; while the selected unit is scattered, those units cannot benefit from Cover.
    - Until the end of the battle round, select up to 2/3/4 friendly units (Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught); those units gain the Stealth ability.

rules.name: Absolutist Principles
rules.description:
For the rest of the battle:
  - Friendly units with the BULLGRYN SQUAD, OGRYN SQUAD or RATLINGS keyword gain the ABHUMAN keyword.
  - Increase the recipients of friendly COMMISSAR models' Voice of Command ability by 1; it can also affect friendly ABHUMAN units.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM units.

rules.name: Designated Targets
rules.description:
Friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY SMOKE or SCOUT SENTINELS units gain the Signal Flares ability:
  - Until the end of the phase, you can: during your Shooting phase, select one enemy unit visible to this model that is within 12" of this unit; that unit is designated as Designated; while the selected unit is designated as Designated, add 3" to that unit's detection range.
You cannot select this Detachment together with another RECON Detachment.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM units.

rules.name: Ceaseless Cannonade
rules.description:
When a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM unit with the SQUADRON or TITANIC keyword is selected to shoot, until the end of the phase:
  - While a friendly unit other than this unit is not within Engagement Range of the target unit, that unit is eligible to shoot even if it is within Engagement Range of enemy units.
  - Unless making attacks made with [INDIRECT FIRE] weapons, that unit ignores any negative modifiers to its Hit rolls.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM units.

rules.name: Squadron Command
rules.description:
For the rest of the battle:
  - Friendly OFFICER units' Voice of Command ability can also affect SQUADRON units.
  - Friendly OFFICER units' Voice of Command ability gains the option On My Signal (nothing happens).
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM units.

rules.name: Order
rules.description: Friendly units' Voice of Command ability gains the option On My Signal (only to friendly ARMOURED SKIRMISHER units: each time an enemy unit ends a Normal or Advance move, once per turn per unit, while the triggering unit is within 8" of this unit, this unit can make a Normal move of up to D6").

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
After deployment, you can use this ability, while this model is on the battlefield:
  - Select up to 3 friendly ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY units other than this unit:
    - For each selected unit:
      - That unit can be set up on the battlefield.
      - That unit can be placed into Strategic Reserves, ignoring any limits on units in Strategic Reserves.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the start of each phase, you can use this ability, once per battle per model, select one enemy unit (excluding MONSTER or VEHICLE units) within 8" of this unit. That unit must take a Battle-shock test.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model gains the Scouts 6" ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Each time an enemy INFANTRY or MOUNTED unit ends a Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge move, while the triggering unit is within 8" of this unit, until the start of your next turn:
  - Roll one D6: on a 4+, the triggering unit is stunned.
  - While the triggering unit is stunned, subtract 1 from the triggering unit's Hit rolls.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Each time this model issues an Order to a friendly SQUADRON unit, once per turn per model:
  - Issue the same Order to one other of the eligible friendly SQUADRON units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model has Feel No Pain 6+.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Add 3 to this model's Objective Control characteristic.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While making ranged attacks, you can re-roll Hit rolls of 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this unit is Battle-shocked, subtract 1 from this unit's Objective Control characteristic.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is leading a unit, while making ranged attacks, if this model remained stationary this turn, this unit scores Critical Hits on Hit rolls of 5+.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: During your Command phase, increase the number of uses of this model's Voice of Command ability by 1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When an enemy unit is set up, while the triggering unit is within 8" of this unit:
  - This model can issue up to 1 Order from Voice of Command to eligible friendly units, not counting toward the Orders it can issue this turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This model's Voice of Command ability can also affect friendly OGRYN units.
This model can also be attached to friendly units with the BULLGRYN SQUAD or OGRYN SQUAD keyword.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model's Voice of Command ability gains the option Target Weak Spot (while making ranged attacks, while the target is within 12" of the attacking unit, improve this unit's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This model's Voice of Command ability gains the option Move to the Shadows (until the attacking unit finishes resolving its attacks, while making ranged attacks, this unit gains the Stealth ability).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time this unit issues an Order, the range of this model's Voice of Command ability is 12".

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Each time this unit issues an Order, while this unit has the Master Vox ability, the number of targets of this model's Voice of Command ability is 3.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
During the first battle round, during your Movement phase, this unit can make an Ingress move.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM MILITARUM TEMPESTUS OFFICER units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the end of your Command phase, if you control one or more objectives, while this unit is within range of an objective marker you control or while the Transport this unit is embarked within is within range of an objective marker you control, until you no longer control it, objective markers this unit controls remain under your control until your opponent's Level of Control over them is greater than yours at the end of a phase.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase, select one friendly TRANSPORT unit (excluding AIRCRAFT or TITANIC units) that is within 3" of this model. You can re-roll Hit rolls for attacks made by that unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This unit has the Benefit of Cover.
While this unit is wholly within 3" of a friendly TRANSPORT unit, this unit gains the Stealth ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: This unit is eligible to disembark even if its Transport Advanced this turn; if it does, it counts as having made a Normal move that phase, and cannot declare a charge this turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: While this model is leading a REGIMENT unit, this unit gains the Scouts 6" ability.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Enemy units cannot target this unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Add 2 to the Attacks characteristic of ranged weapons with [PISTOL] equipped by this model.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Each time an Order is issued to the unit, while this model is leading a unit, the Take Cover option of Voice of Command is active for this unit.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When this unit is selected to shoot, until this unit has resolved its ranged attacks, add 6" to enemy units' detection range.
Applies to: RATLINGS units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This model has Feel No Pain 4+.
Applies to: COMMISSAR units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This unit gains the Infiltrators ability.
Applies to: Scout Sentinels units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
During the first battle round, during your Movement phase, this unit can make an Ingress move.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM INFANTRY PLATOON units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
For the rest of the battle:
  - This model gains the Voice of Command ability.
  - This model gains the OFFICER keyword.
  - The number of uses of this model's Voice of Command ability is 2; it can also affect friendly ASTRA MILITARUM units with the TITANIC or SQUADRON keyword.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC CHARACTER units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
While making ranged attacks, you can re-roll Damage rolls for attacks made by this model.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC CHARACTER units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Each time this model uses Omnissiahs Blessing, until the start of your next Command phase, add 3" to that unit's Move characteristic.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When a unit disembarks from this Transport, if this model made a Normal move this turn, the triggering unit is eligible to declare a charge even if it disembarked this turn.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM TITANIC CHARACTER TRANSPORT units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Each time an Order is issued to the unit, you can use this ability, select up to 2 friendly PLATOON units other than this unit that is within 3" of this unit. Those units are designated as Affected By Order.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER INFANTRY units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, while this unit is unengaged and every model in this unit is within 3" of a friendly ASTRA MILITARUM TRANSPORT unit, this unit is eligible to embark.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER INFANTRY units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
While a friendly ARMOURED SKIRMISHER unit is within 3" of this model, that unit has Feel No Pain 5+.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM TECH-PRIEST ENGINSEER units.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
After deployment, you can use this ability, while this unit is on the battlefield:
  - Select up to 2 friendly units with the REGIMENT or SQUADRON keyword:
    - For each selected unit:
      - That unit can be set up on the battlefield.
      - That unit can be placed into Strategic Reserves, ignoring any limits on units in Strategic Reserves.
Applies to: ASTRA MILITARUM OFFICER units.
